description: An expander for Quad Algorithmic Rhythm, placed immediately to its right, carrying the extra settings the well formed algorithm uses on each track.

params.text: Sets the ratio of long steps to short ones in that track's well formed rhythm; in the middle of its travel a long step lasts twice as long as a short one.
Builds that track's step count and ratio from the nearest well formed track above it instead of from its own settings.
Cycles off, green and yellow: green plays only the beats that the well formed track above does not have at the same moment, yellow measures against every well formed track above.

inputs.text: Voltage adds to that track's long to short ratio, 10V covering the whole travel.
